data.long_meaning: Aakila (عاقلة) is the feminine of ʿāqil, meaning 'intelligent, wise, sensible' — a woman of sound understanding. In Islamic law the unrelated term ʿāqilah denotes a group responsible for payment of blood-money.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name points to sound reason; any spiritual reading placed on it is interpretive and labelled as such.
data.etymology: Feminine of Arabic ʿāqil, from the root ʿ-q-l.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aakila total 17, reducing to 8. Number 8 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.a: Aakila is used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian, Pashto.

faq.q: How is Aakila written in Arabic and Urdu?
faq.a: Aakila is written عاقلة in Arabic and عاقلہ in Urdu, and आक़िला in Devanagari.
